As for evidence... There's the Jammin' Ninja's button.

testimonies.testimony: It was around 11 at night, and I was out on a mobile meet-and-greet around the village.
That's when I saw Dr. Buff being murdered from outside his study window!
Mr. Are'bal snuck up from behind and struck him on the head.
The doctor was standing in front of the bookshelves, absorbed in a book.

I, I d-didn't actually s-see anything myself. No. N-Not until I h-heard that scream.
Anyway, the fact remains! There can't have been anyone else inside that carriage, or we all would have seen!

testimonies.testimony: When the president was pushed off the roof, Shaun was waiting at the film lot.
If Shaun was an accomplice, the problem with the locks would be resolved.
The two of them then hid the president's body.
Inside that monster costume over there...
There's dirt inside the costume. It must have gotten there when the body was hidden inside.

source.evidence_span: The body lying face-up on top of the dirt, and yet there's no dirt on the front of the body.

Fact 2: The evidence suggests there is no dirt on the front of the body.

testimonies.testimony: It happened when I was riding the balloon to the rooftop.
I saw the body double and you, Ms. Gravelle, on the roof. Talk about a surprise.
Only the double noticed me. He told Ms. Gravelle to leave ahead of him.
He then pointed a gun at me and fired.
After the double fired one shot, he entered the hatch to the 51st floor.
